description: This file defines the ProfileFragment class, which manages the user profile interface, handles theme selection, displays user email, and manages user logout functionality within an Android application.

classes.name: ProfileFragment
classes.description: A Fragment managing user profile display, theme preferences, and logout process.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment layout and initializes view binding.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up theme selection and logout click listener, and observes current user data.

methods.name: setupThemeSelection
methods.description: Configures theme selection radio buttons and updates theme accordingly.

methods.name: setupLogout
methods.description: Sets up logout button to sign out user and redirect to login activity.

methods.name: onDestroyView
methods.description: Clears view binding to prevent memory leaks.
